items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Rosetta, my Rosetta, you were told no one but you. You told me that you loved me

ctx.x: I can't wait until that. I can't wait until that. I can't wait until that. I can't wait until that.

I can't wait until that. What do you call that number? A Man I Love. A Man I Love. I just, you know, give me ideas of different, that's all that's a, you know. We played our little drama, we kissed in a field of white, stars from Alabama last night. I can't get for the glamour, arms held around me tight, stars come on Alabama last night. I can't forget in my imagination a situation so heavily. A Ferry Land, why no one else would enter, you said no, it's me. I can't forget that glamour, arms held around me tight,…
